cites.quote: The API works out the local date of the last visit with the hospital time zone
formatted with the web helper `dateTime` in web/src/lib/format.ts, and Last visit reuses it

findings.text: C2 says the API computes a local date, but C3 reuses dateTime(iso, timeZone). That helper parses an instant and also prints hour:minute. A date string passed to it would print a time or the wrong day, so REQ-2 (show a date) and REQ-4 (same format) cannot both hold as written.
